Witness sources: the 112-run corpus, existing Phase-8B archived mission-run seeds/policies and the approved fixed E3 action sequence. No new calibration or parameter changes. The fixture file stores completed runs for reproducible QA; the HTML witness harness is outside production routing. All six browser images are actual rendered UI, not fabricated outcomes.

## Direct facts and continuity

E1 distinguishes integrity below 55 from non-delivery with continuity below 75. E2 lists each failed convoy and both health/deadline criteria. E3 includes integrity, continuity, exact ETA versus T+360 and the missed-minute amount. E4/E6 report resolved attribution and the actual containment flag. E5 explains the existing corroboration condition, never equating attribution with a correct corridor guess.

Continuity contribution delegates to the frozen calculateNetworkContinuity selector on each convoy. Displayed health >=60 and arrival <=deadline checks are asserted against that selector and the final aggregate. The new helper never changes the resolver or domain formula.

## Decision trace and turning points

All eight decisions have chronological cards. Collapsed content shows factual resource, time and evidence changes; expanded content reuses the stored Outcome component, with target, reason, convoy deltas, mitigation activation/expiry and nearby belief checkpoint.

selectTurningPoints ranks each committed decision lexicographically by: mission threshold crossing; resolver-relevant status change; operational-attribution transition; containment transition; persistent mitigation activation (fallback, route hardening, ground support); maximum absolute ETA delta; maximum integrity delta; evidence burst; combined resource expenditure. Temporary escort alone does not receive the persistent-mitigation priority. Earlier round wins all ties. Select five and display chronologically. There is no decision-quality label.

Containment history is absent from public convoy records. After completion only, the helper replays the player's actual actions through createInitialMissionState/applyMissionDecision on an isolated value, and calls the unchanged isThreatContained selector at each transition. It never writes to the completed runtime and never runs this audit in live gameplay. State immutability is asserted.

The report separates direct factors, observed transitions and context; it asserts no counterfactual causal explanation. Resources start at the frozen initial budgets, spending comes from actual records, and final values come from the current state. Evidence starts at zero, is counted by round/source/observed corridor, and distinguishes deliberate detail opens and late evidence. Hidden truth follows the trace. World/seed remain in an expanded replay section. All four belief checkpoints retain their original visible evidence IDs.
